reading_slugs._comment: Maps the slug in a docs/language-reads/ filename to the file that reading read.

rounds._comment: One entry per file: the rounds of two readers run on it. 'agreed' is the count of places BOTH readers of that round stopped at, which is the number that decides whether the file is read clean. Recorded by the session that compared the two reading records.

estimate._comment: Inputs to the est-h and cum-h columns of docs/MEASUREMENTS.html. Each one is a measured or assumed figure, and the page prints the basis under the table. mechanical_minutes_per_100_findings comes from 2026-07-28, where four documents carrying 360 findings reached zero in about half an hour of repair once the two broken checkers were fixed. round_minutes and rounds_expected come from the five rounds run on skills/text-audit/SKILL.md on 2026-07-29: two readers in parallel take about five minutes, and one repair worker takes about twenty. rounds_expected rests on that ONE file, so it is the weakest input here and it is re-seeded once a second file finishes.
